caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile composition with a decorative border made from pink and red embroidered thread forming a zigzag and loop pattern. Inside the border, the central object is a large, geometric vase made up of triangular patches in black, white, and blue colors. Emerging from the vase are stylized, swirling plant forms with leaves in orange, green, blue, and black, some highlighted with white patterns. There are brown, flat, pot-like shapes positioned at the top corners and along the vase's sides. Several brown or black human-like silhouettes are placed symmetrically on both sides of the vase and amidst the plant forms; some of these figures feature stitched additional details such as a skirt or bows in pink thread. Handwritten black text is embroidered at the bottom, reading "My dear James when this you see remember me Mary Slector 1834". The textile is mostly off-white or beige, and there are additional pink stitching elements such as stars and an oval near the upper sides of the central area.
title: Applique Linen Panel
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
